Drone Strike Hits Libya Refinery

A drone strike hit a fuel tank at Libya's Zawiya refinery, causing a fire. The attack occurred at a major gasoline tank in Libya. The refinery is a key fuel source for the country. The drone strike is reported to have caused significant damage. The fire broke out after the attack on the tank. The incident has raised concerns about the security of Libya's energy infrastructure.
